Hi Sophie / billing team,

Welcome — excited to get Invoice Labs set up for payments. To complete vendor activation and issue the first PO, finance needs a couple of items from your side:

- Signed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US)
- VAT registration certificate (if you charge VAT) or confirmation of VAT-exempt status
- Company legal name exactly as it appears on tax forms + EFT/ACH details (bank routing + account; we have a secure upload; do not send account numbers inline if you prefer)
- Point of contact for invoices and the billing email to include on the PO

I've attached our PO template and a short checklist for the procurement intake. Once we receive the W-9 and VAT certificate we can create PO and route for signature — target timeline: 2 business days after docs received.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_template.pdf (PDF), Procurement_Intake_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX)

Please reply with the W-9 (or W-8BEN-E) and VAT certificate attached and confirm the billing email for invoices. If you prefer, I can set up a short 15-minute call to walk through the form.

Thanks,
Marcus
